summary.zh: 测试通过后决定分支如何合并与清理
summary.en: Decide how to merge and clean up a finished branch.

description.zh: 先跑完整测试套件，确认通过后识别仓库与工作树状态，给出发起评审、合并或保留的选项，选定后执行并清理现场。适合功能开发完成、准备合入主干时使用。
description.en: Runs the full test suite first, then inspects the repo and worktree state and presents the integration choices: open a pull request, merge, or keep the branch. Executes the pick and cleans up afterwards. Use once the feature work is done.
